steps.title: Prepare overnight starter culture
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony and inoculate 15 ml synthetic media; grow at 30 °C, 170 rpm overnight (1–2 days depending on strain growth rate).

steps.title: Inoculate main culture with biotin
steps.instruction: Add the overnight culture to 110 ml synthetic media containing 250 nM biotin (typically 3 OD units of cells); grow at 30 °C, 170 rpm for 12 h.

steps.title: Harvest cells at target density
steps.instruction: Collect cells when OD₆₀₀ reaches 0.25 (do not exceed 100 ml at OD₆₀₀ = 0.3). Spin at 2,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, and keep the pellet on ice.

steps.title: Wash cells three times
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellet in 0.5 ml Extraction (E) buffer (4 °C), transfer to a 1.5 ml O‑ring screw‑cap tube, spin 20 s at max speed (4 °C). Repeat washing three times with 1 ml E buffer, vortexing each time, and spin as above; discard supernatant after each spin.

steps.title: Bead‑beat cells and collect lysate
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in 900 µl E buffer, add 0.5 ml 0.5 mm glass beads, and bead‑beat three cycles of 1 min at 2,100 rpm (Mini‑Beadbeater‑96) with 5 min on ice between pulses. Heat a 26‑gauge needle with a gas burner, puncture the bottom of the screw‑cap tube, place the tube into a 12 × 75 mm plastic (FACS) tube, and centrifuge 2 min at 365 × g (4 °C). Discard the screw‑cap tube with beads and transfer the lysate (liquid at the bottom of the FACS tube) to a fresh 1.5 ml microfuge tube.

steps.title: Prepare fresh DMS stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve dimethyl suberimidate (DMS) to 11 mg ml⁻¹ in E buffer (typically 1 ml) at room temperature; use immediately.

steps.title: Take 0‑min sample for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Remove 100 µl of the lysate, add 10 µl (1/10 volume) of 100 % trichloroacetic acid (TCA), incubate 10 min at room temperature, spin 10 min at max speed (room temperature), discard supernatant, wash pellet with 1 ml acetone (room temperature), air‑dry lid open for 30 min, resuspend in 50 µl 2× SDS‑sample buffer, and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Cross‑link with DMS
steps.instruction: Add 1/10 volume of the 11 mg ml⁻¹ DMS stock to the remaining lysate (≈800 µl) to reach a final DMS concentration of 1 mg ml⁻¹; rotate at room temperature for 60 min. Quench by adding 1/20 volume of 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5 to obtain 50 mM final Tris; rotate 15 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Take 60‑min cross‑link sample
steps.instruction: Remove 100 µl of the cross‑linked mixture, add 10 µl (1/10 volume) 100 % TCA, and process exactly as described for the 0‑min sample (incubate 10 min RT, spin, acetone wash, air‑dry 30 min, resuspend in 50 µl 2× SB, store –20 °C).

steps.title: Add Mg²⁺ and Ca²⁺ for MNase digestion
steps.instruction: To the DMS‑cross‑linked sample (~800 µl), add 1/100 volume of 1 M MgCl₂·6H₂O (final ≈10 mM, actually 8 mM due to 2 mM EDTA in E buffer) and 1/100 volume of 0.1 M CaCl₂·2H₂O (final 1 mM); mix at room temperature.

steps.title: Reserve undigested DNA aliquot
steps.instruction: Take 100 µl of the above mixture for later gel analysis and keep on ice.

steps.title: Perform MNase digestion
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the remaining sample at 37 °C in a water bath for 5 min, add 20 µl MNase, invert 5 times, and incubate 37 °C for 20 min. Stop the reaction by adding 1/25 volume of 0.25 M EDTA/EGTA (final 10 mM); invert 5–10 times.

steps.title: Reserve digested DNA aliquot
steps.instruction: Take 100 µl of the MNase‑digested mixture for gel analysis, then spin at 8,000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C; keep the supernatant for the streptavidin pull‑down.

steps.title: Purify DNA for gel analysis (undigested)
steps.instruction: To each 100 µl DNA aliquot, add 5 µl RNase A (10 mg ml⁻¹) and incubate 37 °C for 30 min; add 5 µl 20 % SDS and 2 µl Proteinase K (20 mg ml⁻¹) and incubate 65 °C for 3 h; add 200 µl 7.5 M NH₄Ac and 300 µl ddH₂O; add 600 µl phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (PCI), vortex, spin 5 min at max speed; transfer aqueous phase, precipitate with 1 volume 2‑propanol, spin 20 min at max speed (room temperature); wash pellet with 1 ml 70 % ethanol, spin 5 min, air‑dry 1 h; resuspend in 10 µl TE, add 2 µl 6× loading dye.

steps.title: Run agarose gel for MNase digestion
steps.instruction: Load the purified DNA on a 1.5 % TAE agarose gel containing 0.5 µg ml⁻¹ ethidium bromide; run at 5 V cm⁻¹ for 50 min.

steps.title: Equilibrate and block CL2B beads
steps.instruction: Equilibrate CL2B Sepharose beads with E buffer at 4 °C; block by adding 10 µg insulin per 40 µl bead slurry and rotate 30 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Bind chromatin to CL2B beads
steps.instruction: Add the MNase‑digested supernatant to the blocked 40 µl CL2B bead slurry, rotate 30–60 min at 4 °C; spin 8,000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C. Collect 30 µl supernatant + 30 µl 2× SB as ‘Input’ and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Capture biotinylated nucleosomes
steps.instruction: Transfer the remaining supernatant to a new tube, add 30 µl streptavidin‑Sepharose beads pre‑blocked with insulin (10 µg insulin per 30 µl slurry), rotate 2 h at 4 °C; spin 8,000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C. Collect 30 µl supernatant + 30 µl 2× SB as ‘Unbound’ and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Wash streptavidin beads
steps.instruction: Wash the beads three times with 1 ml Wash (W) buffer at 4 °C, rotating 5 min each wash; after each wash spin 8,000 × g for 1 min at 4 °C and discard supernatant. After the final wash, remove residual liquid with a 26‑gauge needle under vacuum, then resuspend beads in 50 µl 2× SB and store at –20 °C.

steps.title: Prepare samples for Western blot
steps.instruction: Boil all collected samples (0‑min, 60‑min, Input, Bound) at 100 °C for 10 min. Load 10 µl of 0‑min and 60‑min samples, 15 µl of Input, and 8 µl of Bound onto a 17 % SDS‑PAGE gel.

steps.title: Run SDS‑PAGE gel
steps.instruction: Run the gel in 1× SDS‑running buffer at constant 8 mA until bromophenol blue reaches the bottom of the stacking gel, then increase to 18 mA for the resolving gel; continue 15 min after the dye exits the gel (≈2 h total).

steps.title: Transfer proteins to membrane
steps.instruction: Transfer the gel to a nitrocellulose membrane in blotting buffer at constant 0.5 A for 48 min.

steps.title: Block membrane
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane in 5 % non‑fat dry milk/TBST for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate membrane overnight at 4 °C with anti‑V5 antibody diluted 1:10,000 in 5 % milk/TBST.

steps.title: Wash after primary
steps.instruction: Wash membrane three times, 10 min each, with 5 % milk/TBST.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate membrane with anti‑Mouse IgG secondary antibody diluted 1:15,000 in 5 % milk/TBST for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after secondary
steps.instruction: Wash membrane three times, 10 min each, with TBST.

steps.title: ECL detection
steps.instruction: Remove TBST, incubate membrane with 1 ml enhanced chemiluminescence (ECL) solution for 10 min, then detect signal using a ChemiDoc Touch Imaging System (Chemiluminescent Blot mode, highest resolution).
